verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents passkeys alongside SSO, social sign-in and passwords as AuthKit sign-in methods. Its pricing page says AuthKit includes passkeys and magic auth, and the site describes passwordless sign-in via a six-digit code sent by email. Together these cover passkeys, magic-link-style auth and email OTP as built-in options. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on passkey/WebAuthn setup and on configuring magic auth, beyond one-line marketing and pricing mentions; independent or hands-on corroboration.
